name: Group Header 126
definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual charges records included in the message.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the instructing party, and sent to the next party in the chain to unambiguously identify the message.|Usage: The instructing party has to make sure that MessageIdentification is unique per instructed party for a pre-agreed period.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was created.

ChargesRequestor.name: Charges Requestor
ChargesRequestor.definition: Agent that requests the charges, if other than the sender.

TotalCharges.name: Total Charges
TotalCharges.definition: Total charges claimed through this message.

ChargesAccount.name: Charges Account
ChargesAccount.definition: Identifies the account that has been debited or credited for the charges, interest or other adjustment(s).

ChargesAccountOwner.name: Charges Account Owner
ChargesAccountOwner.definition: Agent that owns the charges account.
